name: Cờ Tỷ Phú

categories.label: Last player not bankrupt (winner)
categories.labelVi: Người cuối cùng chưa phá sản (thắng)
categories.hint: Tick for the winner: everyone else is bankrupt.

categories.label: Net worth at stop (cash + property value)
categories.labelVi: Tổng tài sản khi dừng (tiền + giá trị đất)
categories.hint: Optional: only used to decide the winner if the group agrees to stop early.

tiebreakers.description: Early stop only: highest net worth wins (house rule)

winCondition: Monopoly-style game: players aim to drive opponents bankrupt; the last player left not bankrupt wins. Specific edition rules not obtained; the early-stop net-worth comparison is a common house rule, not verified.
notes: family: elimination-economic. Vietnamese Monopoly-style game (Cờ Tỷ Phú); Vietnamese Wikipedia redirects the name to Monopoly. The exact edition rulebook (Fahasa product 8936121102366) was not found; rules inferred from Monopoly. Bankrupt = eliminated.
